entries.title: Infinitary on your iPhone and iPad keeps catching up on a slow connection
entries.body: On a very slow connection, such as weak mobile data, your computer no longer drops Infinitary on your iPhone or iPad about a minute into sending what it missed, which made it start over. Your computer now sends in small pieces and hears after each one that it arrived, so a long catch-up keeps going on the same connection until it is read.
entries.noPicture: The change is in a connection staying up while it catches up, which a still picture cannot show.
